rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling anxious or concerned about someone or something.

example.english: I'm really worried about tomorrow's exam.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 daam1 sam1 ting1 jat6 go3 haau2 si3

rows.note: Use this when you are worried because you do not feel that a person or situation is safe or adequately looked after.

example.english: I'm really worried about my son flying alone for the first time.
example.traditional: 個仔第一次自己搭飛機，我真係唔放心。
example.jyutping: go3 zai2 dai6 jat1 ci3 zi6 gei2 daap3 fei1 gei1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 fong3 sam1

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when worry leaves your mind unsettled or keeps returning to the same concern.

example.english: I was worried all evening because I hadn't handed in the report.
example.traditional: 份報告未交，我成晚都心掛掛。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 mei6 gaau1 ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 sam1 gwaa3 gwaa3
